en: The water is pleasantly hot. {player}'s Pokémon soaked in the spring with {player}.
The rocks round this spring are cracked all over from the volcano's rumbling. I smash them for exercise.
Here, you take this. A young trainer should have it more than an old man.
That's Rock Smash. It breaks a cracked rock clean apart, and something might be hiding underneath.
Ahh, a good soak after smashing rocks. Nothing better for old bones.
